title: Probability: Conditional Probability, Independent Events and Bayes' Theorem
seo_title: Probability Class 12 Worksheet with Answers (NCERT Chapter 13)

meta_desc: Class 12 Probability worksheet (NCERT Chapter 13): conditional probability, the multiplication theorem, independent events, total probability and Bayes' theorem. 100 questions with answers.
body_html:
How it works

  • Conditional probability: P(A|B) = P(A ∩ B) ÷ P(B), the probability of A when we know B has happened.
  • Multiplication theorem: P(A ∩ B) = P(A)P(B|A). Without replacement, the second draw has one fewer item.
  • A and B are independent if P(A ∩ B) = P(A)P(B), so P(A|B) = P(A).
  • Total probability: P(A) = Σ P(Ei)P(A|Ei). Bayes' theorem: P(Ei|A) = P(Ei)P(A|Ei) ÷ Σ P(Ej)P(A|Ej).
Example

A die is thrown. Find P(a 2 | the number is even).

Given even: {2, 4, 6}

One of these three is 2

Answer: 1/3

Common mistakes

  • Dividing by P(A) instead of P(B) for P(A|B).
  • Multiplying P(A)P(B) for events that are not independent.
  • Weighting both bags as 1 when each is chosen with probability ½.
